requirements.title: The library shall release a qualified slab-phone recipe.
requirements.description: The library shall provide at least one accurate or explicitly generic slab phone with qualified front, rear and side views, screen cutouts and whole-device rotation scope.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-LIB-PHONE protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.
